newsitem.title: USA: Perez Companc names new chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Perez Companc names new chiefs.

text.p: Perez Companc SA said Tuesday it has named a new chief executive, chief financial officer and chief operating officer as part of a management restructuring of the energy company.
Oscar Vicente, who most recently was vice president of the company's board of directors, has been named chief executive officer.
Mario Lagrosa has been named chief financial officer and Tadeo Perich has been named chief operating officer.
Lagrosa previously was director of planning and control at Perez Companc, while Perich was vice president of its refining and petrochemical business unit.
All three management titles are new for the company, a spokeswoman said.
The company also said that its administrative and financial director, Jorge Mosquera, has resigned.
